person.name: Marco Reyes
person.traits: Defensive and deflects blame upward. Cracks when confronted with specific victim details.

intro.prompt: Marco leans back, arms crossed. "I don't know what you think I did. People call in about all kinds of things."

choices.text: Let's talk about the calls made from your floor this month.

deny_node.prompt: "I just work off a list. I don't write the scripts, I don't pick the targets. That's not on me."
deny_node.evidence_hint: He's minimizing his role. Confront him with what a specific victim told you.

accepts_evidence.response: His jaw tightens. "...Okay, maybe that one call. That still doesn't prove it was me running things."
He shifts in his seat. "Fine. Maybe. Doesn't mean I'm the one you should be looking at."

choices.text: You're going to need to explain the pattern eventually.

half_crack.prompt: "Look, everyone on that floor made calls like that. Singling me out doesn't get you the people actually running this."
half_crack.evidence_hint: He's hiding behind 'everyone did it.' A second, independent testimony should close that door.

accepts_evidence.response: "...Two of them. Two separate people telling you the same thing." His arms drop.
"...Two of them. Two separate people telling you the same thing." His arms drop.

choices.text: Then give me a name and let's stop pretending you're just a caller.

deny_partial.prompt: Marco stonewalls you. Without a second, independent testimony directly connecting him to specific victims, he has nothing to fear from this conversation yet.

full_crack.prompt: Marco finally deflates. "Okay - okay. It's not just me. There's a whole floor running four different scripts. I can give you names if it keeps me out of the worst of this."

milestone.title: Whistleblower Secured
milestone.detail: Marco Reyes agreed to identify the wider call-center operation once confronted with two independent victim testimonies.

choices.text: Tell me everything, starting with who runs the floor.

end_whistleblower.prompt: Marco's statement, combined with Maria's and Kevin's testimonies, is enough to move on the call center itself. This is no longer circumstantial - it's a built case.
